{{Quote|We'll see. Under Security Appropriations Policy B-71, I am allowed to share classified information&mdash;if you're working for us.|Denal-zon|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Security Appropriations Policy B-71''' permitted officers of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to share classified information with individuals working with the CSF.
